description: This file defines the ChannelStoriesTransformer class, which is responsible for transforming model data related to channel stories, including data retrieval, action URL generation, and links for stories.

classes.name: ChannelStoriesTransformer
classes.description: Class for transforming channel story models, extracting specific fields, and generating URLs for actions and links.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Retrieves raw value for a given key from the model, with special handling for 'id'.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Generates action URLs, such as delete, if the user is available.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates a link to the story based on type and key, specifically for 'id' key.
